newsitem.title: USA: Columbia/HCA cooperated with U.S. agents.
newsitem.headline: Columbia/HCA cooperated with U.S. agents.

text.p: Columbia/HCA Healthcare Corp said Monday that management and employees in its El Paso, Texas, facilities cooperated with federal agents who presented search warrants covering a broad range of records and documents earlier this month.
The warrants were issued March 19, and the information-gathering process was completed by March 20, the company said.
The El Paso division generated about $275 million in revenues in 1996 and had profitability slightly below the corporate average, the company said.
